node.title: BAND CHILD 1 (K3 ARM): the raw positive-433 sub-workboard is closed; exact distinct-slope payment remains
node.statement: DECOMPOSITION CHILD 1 of rate_half_band_closure. Conditional on the exact KoalaBear m2/r4 distinct-affine-slope budget ledger and fresh independent review, the deployed-row K3 structural-supply arm has no unaccounted surplus. The positive 433-1b/O0a raw workboard is now proved empty at 15/15 role cells, 1575 labels, and 25200 signed principal systems. That does not itself close K3: the exact positive router has eleven other named routes after the two proved route closures, and the c112 source-line theorem explicitly leaves coordinate/source-cover orientation assembly open. The budget-ledger premise must therefore provide exhaustive same-owner balanced-core routing, literal route/source-cover integers, genuine-pencil and exact line-count checks for nonzero payments, higher-dimensional ray compilers, and the active allocation inequality. Scope remains the n=2^21 extension-field deployed rows; no transport to n=2^41 prime razor rows is claimed.
node.falsifier: A deployed-row supply object outside the workboard's enumerated classes; a workboard cell whose exclusion fails independent replay; or a labels-to-slopes conversion that changes any cell verdict.
node.notes: Re-audited 2026-08-10 after raw 433-1b workboard closure. The former labels-to-slopes placeholder is decomposed into eleven-route payment, positive-coordinate composition, orientation/source-cover assembly, exact K3 budget ledger, and independent review. Raw-cell closure is complete; route and assembly leaves remain open.
